purpose: Exploratory generated-code then fresh-maintainer feasibility trial, not causal efficacy or token/cost study
design: two domains, one generation per condition/domain, then one fresh neutral maintainer per generated codebase
model: session-inherited model; exact provider snapshot and token telemetry unavailable
guidance_applies_to: generation only; maintainers get identical neutral task instructions
limitations: shared filesystem and tool environment, instruction-level separation only
no randomization, arm letters counterbalanced across domains
task authors and design proposers overlap
acceptance evaluator authored by separate fresh agent before seeing outputs
